scanNote:
6-UNITNING TO'RTINChI BETI (43-bet).

Yuqorida o'ngda 'Food, Glorious Food' va PUShTI-QIZIL yorliqda oq '6'.

CHAP USTUN:
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Speaking'. Ikki qalin savol:
  • 'What is your favourite dish? What do you need to make it?'
  • 'What do you like eating for: BREAKFAST; LUNCH; DINNER?'
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Grammar: Should/Shouldn't'.
• OCh KO'K quti, oq katta harflar 'Giving Advice':
  • 'We use SHOULD/SHOULDN'T to give advice - i.e. to say it would be a good/bad idea for someone to do sth.' To'q sariq qiya: 'You SHOULD drink a lot of water daily. (= It's a good idea.)' / 'You SHOULDN'T drink too much coffee. (= It isn't a good idea.)'
14) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen and write YES or NO next to each sentence. Then, use the sentences to give your partner advice on kitchen hygiene using SHOULD or SHOULDN'T.'
   SURAT: jigarrang to'qima fonda qiyshaygan oq qog'oz varaq, yettita gap va nuqtali joylar:
   1 Wash your dishcloths and hand towels regularly.
   2 Empty the rubbish bins regularly.
   3 Dry your hands on your clothes.
   4 Clean your work surfaces and cooking utensils regularly.
   5 Wash your hands before cooking.
   6 Let your pets sit on your work surfaces.
   7 Cover any wounds when you are preparing food.
   Ostida ko'k qiya namuna: 'You should wash your dishcloths and hand towels regularly.'
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Writing (Project)': 'Use the prompts and the pictures in the Photo File section to write a leaflet about healthy eating.'

O'NG USTUN:
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Communication: a) Polite Requests & Offers'.
15) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen to the short exchanges. Which of them take place in: A FAST-FOOD RESTAURANT? ....... AN EXPENSIVE RESTAURANT? .......'
   IKKI SURAT: chapda - tez ovqat restoranida katakli ko'ylakdagi yigit va jinsi kurtkadagi qiz patnisda gamburger va kartoshka fri bilan; o'ngda - qimmat restoranda oq ko'ylak-galstukli ofitsiant stolda o'tirgan er-xotinga vino quymoqda.
   Oltita qisqa A/B almashinuvi:
   1 A: Are you ready to order, madam? B: Yes. I'll have the mushroom soup as a starter, and the grilled trout for the main course.
   2 A: Can I help you? B: Yes. Can I have a cheeseburger, please?
   3 A: Would you like to see the wine list? B: No, thank you. I'll just have a glass of the house red, please.
   4 A: Do you want anything to drink? B: Yes - a Diet Coke, please.
   5 A: Anything else? B: No, thanks. How much is that?
   6 A: Was everything all right? B: Yes, thank you. Could I have the bill, please?
• To'q sariq 'b) Making, Accepting and Refusing Offers'.
16) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen and fill in the missing phrases. Then, use the prompts to act out similar dialogues.'
   To'q sariq ramkali 1-dialog: A: 1) ......... something to eat? B: Yes, please. I'm starving. A: Well, we've got SANDWICHES. Would you prefer TUNA OR CHEESE? B: 2) ......... A CHEESE SANDWICH, please. (tagi chizilgan so'zlar)
   • soup - chicken/onion
   To'q sariq ramkali 2-dialog: A: 1) ......... A HOT DOG, Steve? B: No, thanks. I'm not very hungry. A: 2) ......... A SALAD, then? B: No, thanks. Just A DIET COKE, please.
   • a hamburger - a piece of apple pie - some coffee

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '43'.

exercises.instructionEn: What is your favourite dish? What do you need to make it? What do you like eating for: breakfast; lunch; dinner?
exercises.instructionUz: Sevimli taomingiz nima? Uni tayyorlash uchun nima kerak? Nonushta, tushlik, kechki ovqatga nima yeyishni yoqtirasiz?
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ 'A DISH' - IKKI MA'NO:

  1) taom ('my favourite dish')
  2) idish, likop ('wash the dishes')

  ⚠ 'to do the dishes' = idish yuvmoq.


⚠ 'FOR BREAKFAST' - ARTIKLSIZ:

  'What do you eat FOR breakfast?'
  ⚠ 'for THE breakfast' - XATO.
  ⚠ Ovqat nomlari (breakfast, lunch,
  dinner) odatda artiklsiz.


⚠ 'LIKE' + -ING:

  'What do you like EATING?'
  ⚠ Britaniyada 'like' dan keyin -ING
  ko'proq.


⚠ 'TO MAKE' + TAOM:

  'to make a salad/a cake/soup'
  ⚠ 'to cook' - issiqda pishirish;
  salat 'cook' qilinmaydi, 'make'
  qilinadi.

items.en: What is your favourite dish? What do you need to make it?
items.uz: Sevimli taomingiz nima? Uni tayyorlash uchun nima kerak?
items.answerEn: My favourite dish is plov. To make it you need rice, meat, carrots, onions and oil.
items.answerUz: Sevimli taomim - palov. Uni tayyorlash uchun guruch, go'sht, sabzi, piyoz va yog' kerak.

items.en: What do you like eating for breakfast?
items.answerEn: For breakfast I like eating bread with butter and honey, and I drink tea.
items.answerUz: Nonushtaga sariyog' va asalli non yeyishni yoqtiraman, choy ichaman.

items.en: What do you like eating for lunch and dinner?
items.uz: Tushlik va kechki ovqatga nima yeyishni yoqtirasiz?
items.answerEn: For lunch I usually have soup, and for dinner I like chicken with rice and a salad.
items.answerUz: Tushlikka odatda sho'rva ichaman, kechki ovqatga guruchli tovuq va salat yoqtiraman.

exercises.explanationUz:
MASLAHAT BERISh - SHOULD.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ShAKLI                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  should + FE'L (to SIZ)
  ⚠ BARCha shaxsda bir xil:
     I/you/he/she/we/they SHOULD
  ⚠ 'He shouldS' - XATO!
  ⚠ 'should TO drink' - XATO!

  INKOR: shouldn't (= should not)
  SAVOL: Should I ...? /
         What should I do?


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  MA'NOSI                         ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  should = ... qilgan ma'qul,
           ... qilish kerak (maslahat)
  shouldn't = ... qilmagan ma'qul

  'You SHOULD drink a lot of water
   daily.' (= yaxshi fikr)
  'You SHOULDN'T drink too much
   coffee.' (= yomon fikr)


⚠ 'SHOULD' va 'MUST' FARQI:

  should = MASLAHAT (bajarish
     ixtiyoriy)
  must = MAJBURIYaT (bajarish shart)

  'You should see a doctor.' -
     maslahat beraman
  'You must see a doctor.' -
     boshqa iloj yo'q


⚠ 'SHOULD' O'QILIShI:

  /ʃʊd/ - 'l' O'QILMAYDI!
  ⚠ 'shouldn't' /ˈʃʊdnt/.


⚠ 'DAILY':

  = har kuni.
  ⚠ 'every day' bilan bir xil.
  ⚠ 'weekly' (har hafta),
  'monthly' (har oy).


⚠ 'I.E.':

  = ya'ni (lotincha 'id est').
  ⚠ 'e.g.' = masalan - ADAShTIRMANG.

points.en: We use should/shouldn't to give advice - i.e. to say it would be a good/bad idea for someone to do sth.
points.uz: should/shouldn't ni maslahat berish uchun ishlatamiz - ya'ni kimdir uchun biror narsani qilish yaxshi/yomon fikr bo'lishini aytish uchun.

points.en: You should drink a lot of water daily. (= It's a good idea.)
points.uz: Har kuni ko'p suv ichishingiz kerak. (= Bu yaxshi fikr.)

points.en: You shouldn't drink too much coffee. (= It isn't a good idea.)
points.uz: Juda ko'p qahva ichmasligingiz kerak. (= Bu yaxshi fikr emas.)

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and write Yes or No next to each sentence. Then, use the sentences to give your partner advice on kitchen hygiene using should or shouldn't.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va har gap yoniga Yes yoki No yozing. So'ng gaplardan foydalanib sherigingizga oshxona gigiyenasi haqida should yoki shouldn't bilan maslahat bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
OShXONA GIGIYENASI.

  ⚠ Audio bor, lekin javoblar
  MANTIQAN aniq: yaxshi odat → Yes,
  yomon odat → No.


JAVOBLAR:

  1 Wash your dishcloths ... → YES
    → You SHOULD wash ...
  2 Empty the rubbish bins ... → YES
    → You SHOULD empty ...
  3 Dry your hands on your clothes
    → NO
    → You SHOULDN'T dry ...
  4 Clean your work surfaces ... → YES
    → You SHOULD clean ...
  5 Wash your hands before cooking
    → YES
    → You SHOULD wash ...
  6 Let your pets sit on your work
    surfaces → NO
    → You SHOULDN'T let ...
  7 Cover any wounds ... → YES
    → You SHOULD cover ...

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'You should wash your dishcloths
   and hand towels regularly.'


⚠ 'HYGIENE':

  = gigiyena, tozalik.
  ⚠ O'qilishi /ˈhaɪdʒiːn/ - 'hay-jin'.


⚠ 'A DISHCLOTH':

  = idish artadigan latta.
  ⚠ 'dish' + 'cloth'.


⚠ 'A RUBBISH BIN':

  = axlat chelagi (Britaniya).
  ⚠ AQShda 'trash can' / 'garbage
  can'.
  ⚠ 'to empty' = bo'shatmoq.


⚠ 'A WORK SURFACE':

  = oshxona ish yuzasi (stol usti).


⚠ 'COOKING UTENSILS':

  = oshxona asboblari (pichoq,
  qoshiq, kapgir).
  ⚠ O'qilishi /juːˈtensəlz/.


⚠ 'TO LET SB DO':

  'Let your pets sit' - 'let' dan
  keyin 'to' SIZ fe'l.
  ⚠ 'let them TO sit' - XATO.


⚠ 'A WOUND':

  = yara, jarohat.
  ⚠ O'qilishi /wuːnd/ - 'vund'.
  ⚠ 'to cover' = yopmoq, bog'lamoq.

items.textEn: 1 Wash your dishcloths and hand towels regularly.
items.uz: Idish lattalari va qo'l sochiqlarini muntazam yuvish - yaxshimi?
items.whyUz:
⚠ Yaxshi odat → 'You SHOULD wash ...'
⚠ Kitobdagi namuna.

⚠ 'You SHOULD empty the rubbish bins regularly.'
⚠ 'to empty' = bo'shatmoq.

items.textEn: 3 Dry your hands on your clothes.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Yomon odat → 'You SHOULDN'T dry your hands on
your clothes.'

items.textEn: 4 Clean your work surfaces and cooking utensils regularly.
items.uz: Ish yuzalari va oshxona asboblarini muntazam tozalash - yaxshimi?
Ovqat pishirishdan oldin qo'l yuvish - yaxshimi?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'You SHOULD wash your hands before cooking.'
⚠ 'before' + -ING.

items.textEn: 6 Let your pets sit on your work surfaces.
items.uz: Uy hayvonlarini ish yuzasiga o'tirishga qo'yish - yaxshimi?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'You SHOULDN'T let your pets sit ...'
⚠ 'let' dan keyin 'to' SIZ fe'l.

items.textEn: 7 Cover any wounds when you are preparing food.

exercises.explanationUz:
LOYIhA TOPShIRIG'I.

⚠ 'A LEAFLET':
  = varaqa, buklet (bir varaqli
  ma'lumot).
  ⚠ 'leaf' (barg) + '-let' (kichik).

⚠ 'HEALTHY EATING':
  = sog'lom ovqatlanish.
  ⚠ 'eating' bu yerda OT (gerund).

⚠ Varaqada 'should/shouldn't'
ishlatiladi: 'You should eat five
portions of fruit a day.'

exercises.instructionEn: Listen to the short exchanges. Which of them take place in: a fast-food restaurant? an expensive restaurant?
exercises.instructionUz: Qisqa suhbatlarni tinglang. Qaysilari tez ovqat restoranida, qaysilari qimmat restoranda bo'lyapti?
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI QISQA SUHBAT.

  ⚠ Audio bor, lekin JAVOB MATNDAN
  ANIQ: ovqat turi va uslub joyni
  ochib beradi.


JAVOBLAR:

  QIMMAT RESTORAN: 1, 3, 6
     1 - 'madam', 'starter',
         'main course', 'grilled trout'
     3 - 'wine list', 'house red'
     6 - 'Could I have the bill'

  TEZ OVQAT RESTORANI: 2, 4, 5
     2 - 'cheeseburger'
     4 - 'Diet Coke'
     5 - 'Anything else? How much is
          that?' (kassada)


⚠ RESTORAN LUG'ATI:

  to order = buyurtma bermoq
  a starter = birinchi taom
     (salat, sho'rva)
  the main course = asosiy taom
  a dessert = shirinlik
  the wine list = vino ro'yxati
  the house red = restoranning o'z
     qizil vinosi
  the bill = hisob (Britaniya)


⚠ MULOYIM ILTIMOS:

  'Can I have ...?' - oddiy
  'Could I have ...?' - MULOYIMROQ
  "I'll have ..." - buyurtma berishda
     eng odatiy


⚠ 'ARE YOU READY TO ORDER?':

  = Buyurtma berishga tayyormisiz?
  ⚠ Ofitsiantning standart savoli.


⚠ 'ANYTHING ELSE?':

  = Yana biror narsa?
  ⚠ 'else' = yana, boshqa.


⚠ 'GRILLED TROUT':

  = panjarada pishirilgan gulmohi.
  ⚠ 'trout' - ko'pligi ham 'trout'.


⚠ 'A DIET COKE':

  = shakarsiz Koka-kola.
  ⚠ 'A Diet Coke' - bir shisha/stakan
  ma'nosida sanaladi.

items.textEn: 1 A: Are you ready to order, madam? B: Yes. I'll have the mushroom soup as a starter, and the grilled trout for the main course.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'madam', 'a starter', 'the main course',
'grilled trout' - qimmat restoran belgilari.

items.textEn: 2 A: Can I help you? B: Yes. Can I have a cheeseburger, please?
3 A: Would you like to see the wine list? B: No, thank you. I'll just have a glass of the house red, please.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'the wine list', 'the house red' - faqat
qimmat restoranda.

items.textEn: 4 A: Do you want anything to drink? B: Yes - a Diet Coke, please.
5 A: Anything else? B: No, thanks. How much is that?
items.whyUz:
⚠ Kassada darhol to'lash: 'How much is that?'
⚠ Qimmat restoranda hisob oxirida so'raladi.

items.textEn: 6 A: Was everything all right? B: Yes, thank you. Could I have the bill, please?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'Was everything all right?' - ofitsiant
so'raydi; 'Could I have the bill' - muloyim.

points.en: A: Are you ready to order, madam? B: Yes. I'll have the mushroom soup as a starter, and the grilled trout for the main course.
points.uz: A: Buyurtma berishga tayyormisiz, xonim? B: Ha. Birinchi taomga qo'ziqorinli sho'rva, asosiy taomga panjarada pishirilgan gulmohi olaman.
points.noteUz:
⚠ "I'll have" - buyurtma berishning odatiy qolipi.
⚠ 'AS a starter', 'FOR the main course'.

points.en: A: Can I help you? B: Yes. Can I have a cheeseburger, please?
points.uz: A: Yordam bera olamanmi? B: Ha. Chizburger bering, iltimos.

points.en: A: Would you like to see the wine list? B: No, thank you. I'll just have a glass of the house red, please.
points.uz: A: Vino ro'yxatini ko'rishni xohlaysizmi? B: Yo'q, rahmat. Faqat bir stakan restoran qizil vinosini olaman.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'the house red' = restoranning o'z qizil
vinosi ('wine' tushirilgan).

points.en: A: Do you want anything to drink? B: Yes - a Diet Coke, please.
points.uz: A: Ichishga biror narsa xohlaysizmi? B: Ha - shakarsiz Koka, iltimos.

points.en: A: Anything else? B: No, thanks. How much is that?
points.uz: A: Yana biror narsa? B: Yo'q, rahmat. Bu qancha turadi?
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'How much is that?' = qancha?
⚠ 'else' = yana, boshqa.

points.en: A: Was everything all right? B: Yes, thank you. Could I have the bill, please?
points.uz: A: Hammasi joyida edimi? B: Ha, rahmat. Hisobni bering, iltimos.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'Could I have' - 'Can I have' dan muloyimroq.
⚠ 'the bill' - Britaniya; AQShda 'the check'.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and fill in the missing phrases.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va tushib qolgan iboralarni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
TAKLIF QILISh, QABUL QILISh, RAD
ETISh.


TO'LIQ DIALOGLAR:

  1 A: WOULD YOU LIKE something to
       eat?
    B: Yes, please. I'm starving.
    A: Well, we've got sandwiches.
       Would you prefer tuna or
       cheese?
    B: I'D LIKE a cheese sandwich,
       please.

  2 A: WOULD YOU LIKE a hot dog,
       Steve?
    B: No, thanks. I'm not very
       hungry.
    A: WHAT ABOUT a salad, then?
    B: No, thanks. Just a Diet Coke,
       please.


⚠ TAKLIF QILISh:

  Would you like ...?
  What about ...? / How about ...?
  Would you prefer A or B?


⚠ QABUL QILISh:

  Yes, please.
  I'd like ..., please.


⚠ RAD ETISh:

  No, thanks. I'm not very hungry.
  ⚠ Rad etganda SABAB aytish
  muloyimlik belgisi.


⚠ "I'M STARVING":

  = ochlikdan o'lyapman (juda och).
  ⚠ 'to starve' = och qolmoq.
  ⚠ So'zlashuvda 'very hungry'
  o'rniga.


⚠ 'WOULD YOU PREFER ...?':

  = qaysinisini afzal ko'rasiz?
  ⚠ 'to prefer' = afzal ko'rmoq.


⚠ 'TUNA':

  = tunets baliq.
  ⚠ O'qilishi /ˈtjuːnə/.


⚠ 'THEN' GAP OXIRIDA:

  'What about a salad, THEN?'
  = Unda salat-chi?
  ⚠ 'then' bu yerda = unda, bo'lmasa.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Well, we've got sandwiches. Would you prefer tuna or cheese?
lines.uz: Bizda sendvichlar bor. Tunetslimi yoki pishloqlimi?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No, thanks. I'm not very hungry.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No, thanks. Just a Diet Coke, please.
lines.uz: Yo'q, rahmat. Faqat shakarsiz Koka, iltimos.

items.whyUz:
⚠ 'Would you like ...?' - muloyim taklif.
⚠ Javob 'Yes, please' - taklif qabul qilindi.

⚠ "I'd like" = 'I would like' - muloyim.
⚠ Savolga mos javob: 'Would you like' → "I'd like".

⚠ 'Would you like a hot dog?'
⚠ Javob 'No, thanks' - rad etildi.

⚠ 'What about ...?' / 'How about ...?' -
boshqa variant taklif qilish.
⚠ 'then' = unda.

exercises.instructionEn: Then, use the prompts to act out similar dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI KO'RSATMA:

  1-dialog uchun: soup - chicken/onion
  2-dialog uchun: a hamburger -
     a piece of apple pie - some coffee


⚠ 'A PIECE OF APPLE PIE':

  = bir bo'lak olmali pirog.
  ⚠ 'pie' - SANALMAYDIGAN bo'lak
  ma'nosida → 'a piece of'.


⚠ 'SOME COFFEE':

  ⚠ 'coffee' sanalmaydigan → 'some'.
  ⚠ 'a coffee' = bir piyola qahva
  (so'zlashuvda).

items.question: A: Would you like something to eat? — B: Yes, please. I'm starving. — A: Well, we've got soup. Would you prefer chicken or onion?
items.answer: B: I'd like chicken soup, please.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'chicken soup' / 'onion soup' - ot + ot.
⚠ "I'd like ..., please" - qabul qilish.

items.prompt: gamburger - olmali pirog - qahva: taklif va rad etish
items.question: A: Would you like a hamburger, Steve? — B: No, thanks. I'm not very hungry. — A: What about a piece of apple pie, then?
items.answer: B: No, thanks. Just some coffee, please.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'a piece of apple pie' - bo'lak.
⚠ 'some coffee' - sanalmaydigan.
